name: tiffin-tracker
description: Tiffin Tracker PWA with native real-time cloud sync and Web Push notifications

scripts.sync:android: node scripts/build-www.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: node scripts/build-www.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease assembleDebug && cd .. && powershell -Command "Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk' 'Tiffin-Tracker-v5.3.3-release.apk' -Force; Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk' 'Tiffin-Tracker-v5.3.3.apk' -Force"
